title: Hold a permit to deal with GMOs in a GMO-free area
what: Deal with a genetically modified organism in an area the Minister has declared GMO-free only under a permit (and a Commonwealth GMO licence where the Gene Technology Act 2000 requires one), unless the dealing is exempt.

sources.title: Genetically Modified Organisms Control Act 2004 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not knowingly deal with a GMO in a GMO-free area unless – (a) that person is authorised to so deal with the GMO by – (i) both a permit and a GMO licence

sources.title: Genetically Modified Organisms Control Act 2004 (Tas)
sources.quote: GMO-free area means, while an order under section 5 is in force, the whole or the part of Tasmania declared by the Minister in the order to be an area that is free of GMOs

administration.who: Secretary of the Department administering the Genetically Modified Organisms Control Act 2004 (Tas)

sources.title: Genetically Modified Organisms Control Act 2004 (Tas)
sources.locator: s 9, words naming the body (found 20 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: The Secretary may grant a permit to a person who has not applied for one under section 8 if – (a) the Minister has declared an area to be a GMO-free area under section 5 or has notified the Secretary that he or she intends to make such a declaration;

reach.condition: if it deals with a genetically modified organism (such as growing a GM crop) in an area declared GMO-free
